subject: Human Body
title: The Menstrual Cycle
description: A 60-second lesson on The Menstrual Cycle.

hook.text: The menstrual cycle isn't a period. It's a 28-day hormonal symphony involving four different hormones and three phases.

buildup.text: FSH triggers egg development. Rising estrogen thickens the uterine lining. LH surges to trigger ovulation mid-cycle.

discovery.text: After ovulation, the corpus luteum produces progesterone, which maintains the lining.

twist.text: Stress, extreme exercise, or low body fat can halt the cycle entirely. The body prioritizes survival over reproduction.

climax.text: The menstrual cycle is hormonal precision.

punchline.text: Four hormones, one cycle, perfect timing. Every single month.

quiz.question: What triggers ovulation?
options: Rising progesterone from the corpus luteum
